Inside was a single sheet of paper, brittle and yellowed. The handwriting was careful and small: 'If you find this, the light still matters. Someone out here is watching for it.' That night he kept the lamp burning past dawn, and he never learned who had been watching.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒来。街灯把空荡荡的马路照成一条昏黄的河，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，轮胎压过积水，声音很快又被寂静吞没。便利店的灯光亮得刺眼，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处的高楼只剩几扇窗还亮着，不知道是谁在熬夜，又是谁刚刚起床。环卫工人推着车慢慢走过，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。风有点凉，空气里带着露水和早点摊刚生起的炉火味。天边还是深蓝色，但再过一会儿，第一班公交车就要出发了。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Picture a stack of nesting dolls: to reach the smallest one, you open each doll and do the same thing again with the doll inside.\n- You always need a stopping point, like the tiniest doll that doesn't open, or you'd keep going forever."}
